newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Yapi Kredi bank GDR offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Turk Yapi Kredi bank GDR offer oversubscribed.

text.p: Yapi ve Kredi Bankasi A.S., one of Turkey's leading commercial banks, said on Wednesday its Global Depository Receipts (GDR) offer on the U.S and European markets was oversubscribed.
"Demand worth $160 million was received for a total of $100 million of YKB (Yapi Kredi Bank) shares offered by (owners) Cukurova Holding and its subsidiaries," the bank said in a statement.
The bank had earlier announced that part of the bank shares kept in the portfolios of the major shareholder Cukurova group would be offered for sale to foreigners in the form of GDRs from June 9.

"The YKB shares were bought by 59 international institutional investors in the offer led by Credit Suisse First Boston and via intermediaries Union Bank of Switzerland, ING Barings, Merrill Lynch, SBC Warburg," the statement said.
It added that the internationally sold shares would be listed on the London stock exchange and be traded at SEAC in London and PORTAL in the US.

"The bank's current situation and active position in the markets played an important role in the success of the offer as well as investors' confidence that the bank's future vision and targets are correctly chosen with high return," the bank said.
